events.title: The Song
events.baseDescription: A song is played at the party.

versions.description: The song fills the room. Gretta stands by the window, listening intently. She seems moved, perhaps by the beauty of the melody.
assumptions: She is simply enjoying the music
She will rejoin the party soon

versions.description: The notes transport me back to Galway. I see Michael standing in the snow, his breath forming clouds in the cold air. The years dissolve away.
assumptions: Michael is still with me in spirit

versions.description: The song echoes through the years. I am standing in the snow again, waiting for her. My love for her is eternal, unchanging.

events.title: The Toast
events.baseDescription: Gabriel gives a speech at the party.

versions.description: I stand before the guests, my words flowing smoothly. They listen attentively. I feel like I belong, like I am part of something greater than myself.
assumptions: I am a worthy member of this family

versions.description: Gabriel speaks eloquently, but my mind wanders. The words blur together. I can only think of Michael, of that winter night so long ago.
assumptions: I am trapped in a life that isn't mine

versions.description: He speaks of love and family, but I know the truth. Gretta's heart belongs to me, not to him. My love is the only real thing.

events.title: The Confession
events.baseDescription: Gretta reveals her secret to Gabriel.

versions.description: Gretta tells me of Michael Furey, of their love, of his death. I feel hollow, as if the ground has opened beneath me. My world shatters.
assumptions: I have been living a lie

versions.description: I tell Gabriel everything. The weight lifts from my chest, but I know I have hurt him. Yet it had to be said - the truth sets me free, even if it destroys us.
assumptions: I have been unfaithful in my heart

versions.description: She remembers me. After all these years, she still remembers. My love was not in vain. I am with her now, in her heart and in her words.
assumptions: I am still alive in her

versions.description: The snow falls silently, covering everything. I understand now. The dead are not gone - they live on in the memories of those who loved them. I have been blind, but now I see.
The snow reminds me of that night in Galway. Michael standing there, so brave, so foolishly in love. I close my eyes and let the memories wash over me.
assumptions: The past is never truly gone

versions.description: The snow falls as it did that night. I am not gone. I am here, in the snow, in her memory, in the quiet moments between heartbeats.
